value: one point for each dollar of Qualifying Purchases
quote: For each dollar of Qualifying Purchases charged to your Dupaco Community Credit Union Dupaco Rewards Visa, you will be awarded one point.
qualifiers: Qualifying Purchases only; excludes balance transfers, cash advances, convenience checks, store value card payments, wire/money transfers, travelers checks and similar cash-convertible items, fees and finance charges, and purchases when account not in good standing

value: There is no limit to the number of points you may earn
quote: There is no limit to the number of points you may earn.

value: Points expire twenty-four (24) months from the date of the purchase that earned the points if not redeemed
quote: If points are not redeemed, points will expire twenty-four (24) months from the date of the purchase that earned the points.
qualifiers: Accumulated points redeemed or expire first-in, first-out

value: Promotional bonus points may take up to 10 weeks to appear
quote: such promotional points may take up to 10 weeks to appear.
qualifiers: Bonus points offered from time to time for certain transactions or promotions

value: Points have no cash or retail value, except for the Cash Rewards option
quote: Except for the Cash Rewards option described below, points have no cash or retail value and may only be used to obtain Dupaco Rewards

value: Redeemed merchandise may be shipped within the 48 contiguous United States only; Gift Cards may be shipped within all 50 states
quote: Redeemed merchandise may be shipped within the 48 contiguous United States only. Gift Cards may be shipped within all 50 states.
You can redeem accumulated points to obtain Dupaco Rewards Visa through Shine online banking at www.dupaco.com.

value: Tickets must be purchased 72 hours in advance of travel dates
quote: Tickets must be purchased 72 hours in advance of travel dates to accommodate processing requirements.

value: Reconfirm flight reservations at least 24 hours prior to departure for domestic and 72 hours prior for international
quote: You should reconfirm flight reservations at least 24 hours prior to departure for domestic reservations and 72 hours prior to departure for international reservations.

value: All airline tickets booked in exchange for points are nonrefundable, non-endorsable and nontransferable
quote: All airline tickets booked in exchange for points are nonrefundable, non-endorsable and nontransferable.
You must make all Travel Rewards reservations via rewards redemption website at www.dupaco.com.

value: Travel Dupaco Rewards may not be used for minors traveling unaccompanied by an adult
quote: Travel Dupaco Rewards may not be used for minors traveling unaccompanied by an adult.

value: Enrollment is automatic following Dupaco approval of your credit request
quote: Enrollment into Dupaco Rewards Visa is automatic following Dupaco Community Credit Union approval of your credit request.
qualifiers: Restricted to Rewards Visa Cardholders in good standing

value: Program participants are required to pay the Rewards points redemption fulfillment fee listed on the redemption website
quote: Program participants are required to pay for the Rewards points redemption fulfillment fee listed on the redemption website.
qualifiers: Amount not stated on this page
